heart_rate.name: Heart rate
measurement_instructions: Sit at rest for 5 min
Measure for 60 s
heart_rate.why_it_matters: Microgravity redistributes body fluids and alters the heart rhythm.

bp_systolic.name: Systolic blood pressure
measurement_instructions: Sit at rest for 5 min
Arm at heart level
bp_systolic.why_it_matters: Changes in gravity affect blood pressure regulation.

bp_diastolic.name: Diastolic blood pressure
measurement_instructions: Taken together with the systolic

spo2.name: Oxygen saturation
measurement_instructions: Pulse oximeter on the index finger, 30 s
spo2.why_it_matters: The air in a closed habitat can fail; SpO₂ detects it early.

mood.name: Mood
measurement_instructions: How do you feel today? 1 = very bad, 5 = very good
mood.why_it_matters: Isolation and confinement affect mood and performance.

temperature.name: Temperature
measurement_instructions: Thermometer under the tongue, 1 min
temperature.why_it_matters: A fever may signal an infection; the immune system changes in space.

glucose.name: Glucose
measurement_instructions: Glucose meter: a drop of blood from the finger
glucose.why_it_matters: Nutrition on a mission is limited, and glucose reflects metabolic status.

exercise_min.name: Daily exercise
measurement_instructions: Minutes of resistance and aerobic exercise today
exercise_min.why_it_matters: Without gravity, bone and muscle are lost; exercise is the countermeasure.

sleep_hours.name: Sleep hours
measurement_instructions: Hours slept last night
sleep_hours.why_it_matters: A disrupted light/dark cycle and noise affect sleep.

vision_changes.name: Vision changes
measurement_instructions: 1 = no changes, 5 = very blurred or distorted vision
vision_changes.why_it_matters: SANS (spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome) appears on long missions in microgravity.

radiation_dose.name: Cumulative dose
measurement_instructions: Reading from your personal dosimeter
radiation_dose.why_it_matters: Outside the magnetosphere, radiation increases the risk of cancer.

hydration_ml.name: Hydration
measurement_instructions: Add up the water and drinks you have had today, in ml
hydration_ml.why_it_matters: Dehydration affects blood pressure, the kidneys and concentration.

weight_kg.name: Weight
measurement_instructions: Fasting, after using the toilet and wearing light clothing
weight_kg.why_it_matters: Sustained weight loss points to poor nutrition or muscle loss.

stress.name: Stress
measurement_instructions: How much stress do you feel today? 1 = none, 5 = a great deal
stress.why_it_matters: Sustained stress in confinement affects sleep, mood and the immune system.

energy.name: Energy
measurement_instructions: How much energy do you have today? 1 = none, 5 = a lot
energy.why_it_matters: Persistent fatigue is an early sign of poor sleep or overload.

loneliness.name: Loneliness
measurement_instructions: Do you feel lonely today? 1 = not at all, 5 = very much
loneliness.why_it_matters: Loneliness is a health risk in isolation and in old age.

sleep_quality.name: Sleep quality
measurement_instructions: How did you sleep? 1 = very badly, 5 = very well
sleep_quality.why_it_matters: Poor sleep reduces attention and increases the risk of errors.

crew_relation.name: Team relationships
measurement_instructions: How are things going with your team? 1 = very badly, 5 = very well
crew_relation.why_it_matters: Conflicts in an isolated group affect mood and safety.

pvt_mean_rt_ms.name: PVT: mean reaction time
measurement_instructions: Calculated by the PVT: tap as soon as the stimulus appears
pvt_mean_rt_ms.why_it_matters: A slower reaction time is an objective marker of fatigue.

pvt_lapses.name: PVT: lapses
measurement_instructions: Calculated by the PVT: responses slower than 500 ms
pvt_lapses.why_it_matters: Attention lapses increase with lack of sleep and fatigue.
